components.name: rr-alert
components.summary: Inline notification banner for success, warning, danger, and info messages. Optionally dismissible.

props.name: variant
props.description: Visual variant and semantic role.

props.name: heading
props.description: Optional bold heading rendered above the body content.

props.name: dismissible
props.description: When true, renders a dismiss button that hides the alert and fires close.

slots.name: icon
slots.description: Optional icon in front of the heading (use <rr-icon>).

events.name: close
events.detail: Fired when the dismiss button is clicked (only when dismissible).

rules: Never use hex values — always var(--color-*) or var(--component-*)
Never reference --primitive-* tokens in component code
All text/background pairings must pass WCAG AA (4.5:1)
Use alert for form-level or system feedback; for field-level validation use rr-input error-text instead

examples.title: Danger, dismissible
examples.html: <rr-alert variant="danger" heading="Upload failed" dismissible>The file could not be processed.</rr-alert>

examples.title: Info with icon
examples.html:
<rr-alert variant="info" heading="Heads up">
  <rr-icon slot="icon" name="info"></rr-icon>
  Maintenance is scheduled for tonight.
</rr-alert>

keyboard: Tab moves focus to the dismiss button when dismissible
Enter or Space activates the dismiss button
rules: Do not rely on color alone to convey the alert variant — pair with a heading or icon
The dismiss button carries an aria-label of "Dismiss"

components.name: rr-avatar
components.summary: Circular identity surface showing initials or an image, with size and accent-color variants.

props.name: size
props.description: Circle diameter.

props.name: color
props.description: Accent-bold color variant for the initials surface.

props.name: name
props.description: Full name used to derive up to two initials and the accessible label.

props.name: src
props.description: Image URL. When set, an img fills the circle instead of initials.

props.name: alt
props.description: Alt text for the image; falls back to name when omitted.

slots.name: default
slots.description: Optional custom content to replace initials (e.g. an icon).

cssParts.name: img
cssParts.description: The img element (only when src is set).

rules: Never use hex values — always var(--color-*) or var(--component-*)
Never reference --primitive-* tokens in component code
All text/background pairings must pass WCAG AA (4.5:1)
Always provide name (or alt when using src) so the avatar has an accessible label
Initials avatars expose role=img with aria-label set to name; the initials text itself is aria-hidden
Image avatars derive alt from the alt prop, falling back to name

components.name: rr-badge
components.summary: Status badge and accent chip. 9 variants map to component tokens; brand theming cascades via CSS custom properties.

props.name: variant
props.description:
Visual variant. Status variants (success, warning, danger, info) convey
semantic meaning. Accent variants are decorative emphasis tags.

rules: Never use hex values. Always use var(--color-*) or var(--component-*)
Never reference --primitive-* tokens in component code
All text/background pairings must pass WCAG AA (4.5:1)

Variants use a subtle style: a tinted background with accent-colored text, not a solid fill. component-badge-{variant}-foreground is the accent color itself (e.g. foreground-success), not foreground-on-{variant}.
To make a variant solid instead (bright fill + dark text), repoint its component tokens to background-{variant} and foreground-on-{variant}; consumer code does not change.
Add role="status" on the host element when badge content updates dynamically to create an ARIA live region.
Decorative badges (accent-*) do not need role="status"; they are static labels.
Badge text alone must convey meaning; do not rely solely on color to distinguish variants.

components.name: rr-button
components.summary: Button with primary/secondary/danger/ghost variants, three sizes, loading spinner, and full keyboard/form semantics.

props.name: variant
props.description: Visual variant: primary (filled CTA), secondary (outlined), danger (destructive), ghost (text-only, quiet).

props.name: size
props.description: Size: sm, md, lg. Controls padding and font size.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Disables the button. Prevents click and removes from tab order.

props.name: loading
props.description: Shows a spinner and sets aria-busy. Click suppressed while loading.

props.name: type
props.description: Button type attribute: button, submit, or reset.

props.name: aria-label
props.description: Accessible label. Required for icon-only buttons.

slots.name: prefix
slots.description: Icon or element before the label.

slots.name: suffix
slots.description: Icon or element after the label.

events.name: click
events.detail: Native click event. Suppressed when disabled or loading.

rules: Never use hex values. Always use var(--color-*) or var(--component-*)
Never reference --primitive-* tokens in component code
All text/background pairings must pass WCAG AA (4.5:1)
Primary button: one per page maximum
Icon-only buttons must have aria-label

keyboard: Enter activates the button
Space activates the button
Tab moves focus to/from the button
rules: delegatesFocus ensures host element forwards focus to inner <button>.
aria-busy='true' set during loading state to communicate to AT.
Icon-only buttons require aria-label for accessible name.
disabled attribute removes from tab order and prevents activation.
Click events are suppressed when disabled or loading.

components.name: rr-card
components.summary: Surface container on the elevated background tier with optional header, body, and footer slots.

props.name: padding
props.description:
Internal padding around the body slot.
Header and footer padding is always fixed at `tight/element`.

slots.name: header
slots.description: Card heading row (title, actions, avatar). Hidden when empty.

slots.name: footer
slots.description: Card footer row (secondary actions, metadata). Hidden when empty.

rules: Never use hex values — always var(--color-*) or var(--component-*)
Never reference --primitive-* tokens in component code
All text/background pairings must pass WCAG AA (4.5:1)
Use background.alt for surface separation rather than a shadow token

examples.title: Header, body, footer
examples.html:
Card title

Card body text.

Last updated today

rules: Card is a presentational container with no implicit role; use a heading element in the header slot for document structure

components.name: rr-checkbox
components.summary: Form-associated checkbox with checked, indeterminate, and disabled states. Backed by ElementInternals.

props.name: checked
props.description: Whether the checkbox is checked.

props.name: indeterminate
props.description: Mixed state; cleared when the user toggles the checkbox.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Disables interaction and form participation.

props.name: value
props.description: Form value submitted when checked.

props.name: name
props.description: Form field name.

props.name: label
props.description: Label text; falls back to slotted content when empty.

slots.name: default
slots.description: Label text (alternative to the label property).

events.name: change
events.detail: Fired when the checked state changes.

rules: Never use hex values — always var(--color-*) or var(--component-*)
Never reference --primitive-* tokens in component code
All text/background pairings must pass WCAG AA (4.5:1)
Always provide a label (via the label prop or slotted content) so the control is named

examples.title: Checked
examples.html: <rr-checkbox name="agree" label="I agree to the terms" checked></rr-checkbox>

keyboard: Tab moves focus to the checkbox
Space toggles the checked state
rules: A hidden native input provides focus, keyboard, and label-click semantics
aria-checked is set to "mixed" while indeterminate, otherwise "true"/"false"

components.name: rr-dialog
components.summary: Modal dialog built on the native <dialog> element with focus trap and Escape-to-close.

props.name: heading
props.description: Dialog title text rendered in the header.

props.name: open
props.description: Whether the dialog is open. Reflected to an attribute.

props.name: close-on-backdrop
props.description: Close the dialog when the backdrop is clicked.

slots.name: footer
slots.description: Action buttons, displayed in a right-aligned footer row. Footer is hidden when empty.

events.name: rr-dialog-close
events.detail: Fired whenever the dialog closes — via Escape, the close button, backdrop click, or programmatic close(). Bubbles and is composed.

rules: Never use hex values — always var(--color-*) or var(--component-*)
Never reference --primitive-* tokens in component code
All text/background pairings must pass WCAG AA (4.5:1)
Open and close the dialog via the open property or the show()/close() methods — both keep state and the rr-dialog-close event in sync

examples.title: Confirmation dialog with footer actions
examples.html:
<rr-dialog heading="Confirm action" open>
  Are you sure you want to delete this item?
  <rr-button slot="footer" variant="danger">Delete</rr-button>
  <rr-button slot="footer" variant="secondary">Cancel</rr-button>
</rr-dialog>

examples.title: Non-dismissible backdrop
examples.html:
<rr-dialog heading="Processing" close-on-backdrop="false" open>
  Please wait while we finish.
</rr-dialog>

keyboard: Escape closes the dialog
Tab and Shift+Tab cycle focus within the dialog (native modal focus trap via showModal())
Enter or Space activates the close button when focused
rules: Provide a heading so the dialog has an accessible name
The close button always carries aria-label="Close dialog"

components.name: rr-icon
components.summary: Sized, accessible wrapper for inline SVG icons. Decorative by default; labelled icons become role="img".

props.name: size
props.description: Icon size, mapped to the icon-size design tokens. Reflected to an attribute.

props.name: aria-label
props.description: Accessible label. When set, the host gets role="img"; otherwise it is aria-hidden="true" (decorative).

slots.name: default
slots.description: The SVG icon element to render.

rules: Never use hex values — always var(--color-*) or var(--component-*)
Never reference --primitive-* tokens in component code
All text/background pairings must pass WCAG AA (4.5:1)
Icon color is inherited from the parent — set color on the surrounding element, not the icon
Omit aria-label for purely decorative icons — the component applies aria-hidden="true" automatically
Set aria-label only when the icon conveys meaning not present in adjacent text — it then gets role="img"

components.name: rr-input
components.summary: Form-associated text input with label, helper/error text, and ElementInternals for native form participation.

props.name: type
props.description: Input type attribute (text, email, password, etc.).

props.name: name
props.description: Form field name for submission.

props.name: value
props.description: Current input value.

props.name: placeholder
props.description: Placeholder text shown when empty.

props.name: label
props.description: Visible label text above the input.

props.name: helper-text
props.description: Helper text below the input. Hidden when error-text is set.

props.name: error-text
props.description: Error message below the input. Sets aria-invalid and replaces helper text.

props.name: required
props.description: Marks the field as required. Shows asterisk and sets aria-required.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Disables the input.

props.name: autocomplete
props.description: Autocomplete hint for browser autofill.

slots.name: label
slots.description: Optional override for the label content.

events.name: input
events.detail: Fired on each keystroke, mirrors native input event.

events.name: change
events.detail: Fired on value commit (blur), mirrors native change event.

cssParts.name: label
cssParts.description: The label element above the input.

rules: Never use hex values. Always use var(--color-*) or var(--component-*)
Never reference --primitive-* tokens in component code
All text/background pairings must pass WCAG AA (4.5:1)

keyboard: Tab moves focus to the input
Standard text editing keys work natively
rules: aria-errormessage points to error div; aria-describedby mirrors the link while invalid as AT fallback.
When valid, aria-describedby points to helper text. When invalid, it switches to error text.
delegatesFocus ensures host element forwards focus to inner <input>.
ElementInternals.setFormValue() keeps the form value in sync with the input.

components.name: rr-link
components.summary: Anchor enforcing the design system link style — underlined by default, underline removed on hover.

props.name: href
props.description: Link destination.

props.name: target
props.description: Browsing context. Use "_blank" to open in a new tab.

props.name: rel
props.description: rel attribute. Defaults to "noopener noreferrer" when target="_blank" unless overridden.

props.name: variant
props.description: Colour variant. Reflected to an attribute.

props.name: aria-label
props.description: Accessible label forwarded to the anchor when link text alone is insufficient.

rules: Never use hex values — always var(--color-*) or var(--component-*)
Never reference --primitive-* tokens in component code
All text/background pairings must pass WCAG AA (4.5:1)
Links are underlined by default and lose the underline on hover — do not override this inverted convention

keyboard: Enter activates the link
Tab moves focus to and from the link
rules: rel="noopener noreferrer" is applied automatically for target="_blank" to prevent reverse tabnabbing
Provide aria-label when the visible link text is not descriptive on its own

components.name: rr-menu
components.summary: Dropdown action menu (WAI-ARIA menu-button pattern) with full keyboard navigation, Escape/outside-click dismissal, and trigger ARIA wiring.

props.name: open
props.description: Whether the menu is open. Usually driven by the component itself; settable for controlled usage.

props.name: placement
props.description: Which edge of the trigger the menu aligns to: bottom-start (default) or bottom-end.

props.name: label
props.description: Accessible label for the menu popup (required); sets aria-label on the role=menu element.

slots.name: trigger
slots.description: The control that opens the menu (e.g. an rr-button).

events.name: rr-menu-select
events.detail: Fired when an item is chosen; detail.value is the item's value.

events.name: rr-menu-toggle
events.detail: Fired when the menu opens or closes; detail.open is the new state.

rules: Never use hex values. Always use var(--color-*) semantic tokens
Never reference --primitive-* tokens in component code
All text/background pairings must pass WCAG AA (4.5:1)
Always set label — it names the menu popup for assistive tech
The popup positions with CSS below the trigger (no portal) — keep the menu outside overflow:hidden ancestors

examples.title: Row actions menu
examples.html:
<rr-menu label="Row actions">
  <rr-button slot="trigger" variant="secondary">Actions</rr-button>
  <rr-menu-item value="edit">Edit rule</rr-menu-item>
  <rr-menu-item value="duplicate">Duplicate</rr-menu-item>
  <rr-menu-item value="delete" danger>Delete rule</rr-menu-item>
</rr-menu>

keyboard: Enter, Space, or click on the trigger toggles the menu
ArrowDown on the trigger opens and focuses the first item; ArrowUp opens focusing the last
ArrowDown/ArrowUp move through enabled items and wrap; Home/End jump to the ends
Enter or Space activates the focused item
Escape closes and returns focus to the trigger; Tab closes and moves on
rules: The slotted trigger receives aria-haspopup=menu and live aria-expanded automatically
Disabled items are skipped by keyboard navigation and are inert to clicks
Focus returns to the trigger on Escape and on item selection

components.name: rr-menu-item
components.summary: A single action inside rr-menu; the host carries role=menuitem and focus is managed by the parent menu.

props.name: value
props.description: Value reported in rr-menu's rr-menu-select event when this item is chosen.

props.name: danger
props.description: Marks a destructive action — danger foreground, red-tinted hover.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Disables the item — skipped by keyboard navigation, click is inert.

events.name: rr-menu-item-select
events.detail: Bubbles (composed) to rr-menu when the item is activated; detail.value is this item's value. Not fired when disabled.

rules: Never use hex values. Always use var(--color-*) semantic tokens
Never reference --primitive-* tokens in component code
All text/background pairings must pass WCAG AA (4.5:1)
Reserve danger for genuinely destructive actions — one per menu is the norm
Do not rely on color alone for the danger signal — the label must say what is destroyed

keyboard: Enter or Space activates the item
Focus arrives via the parent menu's roving keyboard navigation
rules: role=menuitem and tabindex=-1 live on the host so the flattened tree reads menu → menuitem
Disabled items expose aria-disabled=true and stay visible — hidden options are undiscoverable options

components.name: rr-progress
components.summary: Horizontal progress bar with determinate and indeterminate modes, using native role="progressbar".

props.name: value
props.description: Current value (0–max). Ignored when indeterminate.

props.name: max
props.description: Maximum value.

props.name: indeterminate
props.description: Show an animated indeterminate state instead of a fixed value. Reflected to an attribute.

props.name: label
props.description: Accessible label, applied as aria-label. Required when no visible label is nearby.

rules: Never use hex values — always var(--color-*) or var(--component-*)
Never reference --primitive-* tokens in component code
All text/background pairings must pass WCAG AA (4.5:1)
Always provide a label (or an external visible label) so the progressbar has an accessible name
aria-valuenow is omitted and aria-busy="true" is set in indeterminate mode
aria-valuemin is always 0 and aria-valuemax tracks the max prop

components.name: rr-radio
components.summary: Individual radio button. Must be used inside rr-radio-group, which manages name, value, and selection.

props.name: value
props.description: The value this radio contributes to the group when selected.

props.name: checked
props.description: Visual checked state. Managed by the parent rr-radio-group.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Disables the radio.

rules: Never use hex values — always var(--color-*) or var(--component-*)
Never reference --primitive-* tokens in component code
All text/background pairings must pass WCAG AA (4.5:1)
Always use rr-radio inside an rr-radio-group — selection, name, and form value are managed by the group

keyboard: Space selects the focused radio
Arrow-key navigation and roving focus are handled by the parent rr-radio-group

components.name: rr-radio-group
components.summary: Form-associated group of radio buttons. Renders a fieldset/legend and manages selection and form value for its rr-radio children.

props.name: name
props.description: Form field name submitted with the selected value.

props.name: value
props.description: Selected radio value. Syncs the checked state of child radios.

props.name: label
props.description: Group label rendered as the legend.

props.name: errorText
props.description: Error message; sets data-invalid and a custom validity. Maps to attribute error-text.

props.name: required
props.description: Marks the group as required.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Disables the group and all child radios.

props.name: orientation
props.description: Layout direction of the radio options.

rules: Never use hex values — always var(--color-*) or var(--component-*)
Never reference --primitive-* tokens in component code
All text/background pairings must pass WCAG AA (4.5:1)
Place rr-radio elements in the default slot; the group manages their checked state and form value

examples.title: Default vertical group
examples.html:
<rr-radio-group name="size" label="Size" value="md">
  <rr-radio value="sm">Small</rr-radio>
  <rr-radio value="md">Medium</rr-radio>
  <rr-radio value="lg">Large</rr-radio>
</rr-radio-group>

examples.title: Error state
examples.html:
<rr-radio-group name="size" label="Size" required error-text="Please select a size">
  <rr-radio value="sm">Small</rr-radio>
  <rr-radio value="md">Medium</rr-radio>
</rr-radio-group>

keyboard: Arrow keys move selection within the group
Tab moves focus into and out of the group

components.name: rr-select
components.summary: Form-associated select dropdown with label, helper text, and error state. Options supplied via the options property.

props.name: name
props.description: Form field name submitted with the selected value.

props.name: value
props.description: Selected option value.

props.name: label
props.description: Field label rendered above the select.

props.name: helperText
props.description: Helper text shown when there is no error. Maps to attribute helper-text.

props.name: errorText
props.description: Error message; sets data-invalid and a custom validity. Maps to attribute error-text.

props.name: required
props.description: Marks the field as required and shows an asterisk.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Disables the select.

props.name: options
props.description: Options to render: array of { value: string; label: string; disabled?: boolean }.

rules: Never use hex values — always var(--color-*) or var(--component-*)
Never reference --primitive-* tokens in component code
All text/background pairings must pass WCAG AA (4.5:1)
Reuses the shared --component-input-* token set (covers text input, textarea, and select)

examples.title: Required with error
examples.html: <rr-select label="Pick one" name="choice" required error-text="Please select an option"></rr-select>

keyboard: Space or Enter opens the native option list
Arrow keys move between options
Type-ahead jumps to a matching option
rules: Built on a native select element; label, error, and helper are wired via for/aria-describedby/aria-errormessage

components.name: rr-skeleton
components.summary: Animated shimmer placeholder for loading states. Text, circular, and rectangular shape variants.

props.name: variant
props.description: Shape of the skeleton.

props.name: width
props.description: CSS width value. Defaults to 40px for circular, otherwise 100%.

props.name: height
props.description: CSS height value. Defaults to 40px for circular, otherwise 1em.

rules: Never use hex values — always var(--color-*) or var(--component-*)
Never reference --primitive-* tokens in component code
All text/background pairings must pass WCAG AA (4.5:1)
Decorative placeholder only — the inner element is role=presentation and aria-hidden, so it is excluded from the accessibility tree
Decorative only: marked role=presentation and aria-hidden. Announce loading state with a separate live region if needed.

components.name: rr-spinner
components.summary: Animated circular loading indicator that announces its status to screen readers.

props.name: size
props.description: Visual size of the spinner. Reflected to the size attribute.

props.name: label
props.description: Accessible label announced to screen readers via the status region.

rules: Never use hex values — always var(--color-*) or var(--component-*)
Never reference --primitive-* tokens in component code
All text/background pairings must pass WCAG AA (4.5:1)
The decorative SVG is aria-hidden; the visible label lives in a visually hidden role=status region with aria-live=polite.

components.name: rr-tab
components.summary: A single tab button used inside rr-tab-list; its selection state is managed by the parent.

props.name: value
props.description: Unique identifier for this tab; must match the value rr-tab-list uses for selection. Reflected.

props.name: selected
props.description: Marks the active tab. Set by the parent rr-tab-list — do not set directly. Reflected.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Prevents selection. Reflected.

events.name: rr-tab-select
events.detail: Bubbles (composed) to rr-tab-list when the tab is clicked; detail.value is this tab's value. Not fired when disabled or already selected.

rules: Never use hex values — always var(--color-*) or var(--component-*)
Never reference --primitive-* tokens in component code
All text/background pairings must pass WCAG AA (4.5:1)
Do not set selected directly — control the active tab via rr-tab-list[value].

keyboard: Enter or Space activates the focused tab via its native button
rules: Roving tabindex (selected tab is 0, others -1) and aria-selected are managed in concert with rr-tab-list.
Host uses delegatesFocus so focus forwards to the inner button.

components.name: rr-tab-list
components.summary: Accessible tab strip that wraps rr-tab elements, managing selection and arrow-key navigation.

props.name: label
props.description: Accessible label for the tablist (required); sets aria-label on the role=tablist element.

props.name: value
props.description: Currently selected tab value. Reflected; syncs the matching rr-tab child's selected state.

events.name: change
events.detail: Fired (bubbles, composed) when a tab is selected by click or keyboard; detail.value is the newly selected tab value.

rules: Never use hex values — always var(--color-*) or var(--component-*)
Never reference --primitive-* tokens in component code
All text/background pairings must pass WCAG AA (4.5:1)
Tab panels are managed by the consuming app — listen for the change event and show/hide content accordingly.

examples.title: Default
examples.html:
<rr-tab-list label="View options" value="overview">
  <rr-tab value="overview">Overview</rr-tab>
  <rr-tab value="details">Details</rr-tab>
  <rr-tab value="settings">Settings</rr-tab>
</rr-tab-list>

keyboard: ArrowRight moves selection to the next enabled tab (wraps)
ArrowLeft moves selection to the previous enabled tab (wraps)
Home selects the first enabled tab
End selects the last enabled tab
rules: Implements roving tabindex across child rr-tab elements; disabled tabs are skipped during arrow navigation.
label is required so the tablist has an accessible name via aria-label.

components.name: rr-table
components.summary: Structural data table (CSS table layout + ARIA table roles) owning zebra, hover, and selected row states for the whole family.

props.name: label
props.description: Accessible name for the table (required); sets aria-label on the role=table host.

props.name: density
props.description: Row density: default (12/16 cell padding) or compact (8/12) for data-dense surfaces.

props.name: zebra
props.description: Zebra-stripes even body rows with the elevated surface fill.

props.name: interactive
props.description: Marks rows as clickable: enables the green hover tint and pointer cursor.

slots.name: header
slots.description: A single rr-table-row of header cells (rr-table-cell header).

rules: Never use hex values. Always use var(--color-*) semantic tokens
Never reference --primitive-* tokens in component code
All text/background pairings must pass WCAG AA (4.5:1)
Always set label — it names the table for assistive tech
Set interactive only when rows actually respond to clicks — the hover tint is an interactivity signal, never decoration

examples.title: Zebra table
examples.html:
<rr-table label="Rules" zebra>
  <rr-table-row slot="header">
    <rr-table-cell header>Rule</rr-table-cell>
    <rr-table-cell header numeric>Amount</rr-table-cell>
  </rr-table-row>
  <rr-table-row>
    <rr-table-cell>High-value approvals</rr-table-cell>
    <rr-table-cell numeric>25,000</rr-table-cell>
  </rr-table-row>
</rr-table>

keyboard: Interactive content inside cells (menus, buttons, links) keeps its own keyboard behavior; the table adds none
rules: The host carries role=table with aria-label from the label prop; shadow rowgroups carry role=rowgroup
Because layout is CSS tables (not <table>), the explicit ARIA roles on host/rows/cells are the semantics — do not remove them
Selected rows expose aria-selected=true

components.name: rr-table-cell
components.summary: A cell inside rr-table-row; header cells get the muted all-caps recipe, numeric cells right-align in mono with tabular figures.

props.name: header
props.description: Renders the cell as a column header (role=columnheader, muted all-caps recipe).

props.name: numeric
props.description: Right-aligns the cell in mono with tabular figures — for amounts, counts, IDs.

slots.name: (default)
slots.description: Cell content — text, badges, menus, buttons.

rules: Never use hex values. Always use var(--color-*) semantic tokens
Never reference --primitive-* tokens in component code
All text/background pairings must pass WCAG AA (4.5:1)
Use numeric for amounts, counts, and IDs so digit columns align — not for text that happens to contain digits

keyboard: None of its own — slotted interactive content keeps its native keyboard behavior
rules: role=cell flips to role=columnheader when header is set, including at runtime
Padding follows the parent table's density via inherited custom properties

components.name: rr-table-row
components.summary: A row inside rr-table; carries role=row, its zebra/hover/selected visuals are painted by the parent table's stylesheet.

props.name: selected
props.description: Marks the row as selected — tint fill plus the solid action rail, strongest row state.

rules: Never use hex values. Always use var(--color-*) semantic tokens
Never reference --primitive-* tokens in component code
Drive selected from your selection model — it is the only state the row owns

keyboard: None of its own — interactive cell content keeps its native keyboard behavior

components.name: rr-tag
components.summary: Outlined uppercase tag/chip — the square, transparent counterpart to the filled pill badge. Two emphasis variants via component tokens.

props.name: variant
props.description:
Emphasis level. `default` is the standard visible outline (alt text,
muted-foreground border) that reads correctly standalone — use it for skill
tags and most labels. `subtle` is a quieter treatment (muted text,
elevated-border) for dense or secondary contexts.

slots.name: default
slots.description: Tag label text. Rendered uppercase via CSS — pass normal-case text.

rules: Never use hex values. Always use var(--color-*) or var(--component-*)
Never reference --primitive-* tokens in component code
All text/background pairings must pass WCAG AA (4.5:1)
The tag is the deliberate inverse of the badge: outlined (transparent fill, square radius.sm) vs the badge's filled pill. Use badge for status, tag for skills/categories/metadata.

Do not point a tag border at --color-border-default: it equals background.alt and disappears on the page canvas. The default variant uses foreground.muted and the subtle variant uses border.elevated so both stay visible standalone.
Content is transformed to uppercase with --letter-spacing-all-caps in CSS; authors pass normal-case text and must not pre-uppercase it.
Tags are non-interactive labels. If a tag must be clickable (e.g. a filter), wrap it in an rr-button or rr-link — do not attach handlers to the tag host.
Tag text alone must convey meaning; do not rely on the border or emphasis level to communicate.
Tags are static, non-interactive labels — they are not focusable and expose no role. For interactive chips, compose with rr-button or rr-link.
Both variants meet WCAG AA for text contrast on the base canvas (default 8.0:1, subtle 6.3:1).

props.description: Auto-dismiss after this many milliseconds. 0 (default) means persistent until dismissed. Timer pauses while hovered or focused.

events.detail: Fired when the toast closes. detail.reason is 'dismiss' | 'timeout' | 'programmatic'.

rules: Never use hex values. Always use var(--color-*) semantic tokens
Never reference --primitive-* tokens in component code
All text/background pairings must pass WCAG AA (4.5:1)
Placement is the consumer's job — render toasts inside a fixed-position region; the component owns the surface, not the position
Do not rely on the accent color alone to convey the variant — pair with a heading

examples.title: Danger, persistent
examples.html: <rr-toast variant="danger" heading="Upload failed">The file could not be processed.</rr-toast>

examples.title: With undo action
examples.html:
<rr-toast heading="Rule deleted">
  "High-value approvals" was removed.
  <rr-button slot="action" variant="ghost" size="sm">Undo</rr-button>
</rr-toast>

keyboard: Tab moves focus to the action and dismiss button
Enter or Space activates the focused control
The auto-dismiss timer pauses while the toast is hovered or holds focus
rules: role=status with aria-live=polite by default; the danger variant escalates to role=alert / assertive
The dismiss button carries an aria-label of "Dismiss"
Never put the only path to an action inside an auto-dismissing toast — duration must be 0 when an action slot is used, or the action must exist elsewhere

declarations.description:
`<rr-table-cell>` — a cell inside `rr-table-row`.

The host carries `role="cell"` (or `role="columnheader"` when `header` is
set) and lays out as a CSS table cell. Padding comes from the parent
table's density via inherited custom properties. Cells accept arbitrary
content — text, badges, menus, buttons.

Header cells render the system's column-header recipe: muted, uppercase,
all-caps tracking, label-strong-small. Numeric cells right-align in
mono with tabular figures so digit columns line up.
declarations.name: RrTableCell

members.name: header
members.description: Renders the cell as a column header (role=columnheader, muted all-caps recipe).

members.name: numeric
members.description: Right-aligns the cell in mono with tabular figures — for amounts, counts, IDs.

declarations.description:
`<rr-table-row>` — a row inside `rr-table`.

The host carries `role="row"` and lays out as a CSS table row; its visual
states (zebra, hover, selected fill and rail) are painted by the parent
rr-table's stylesheet so every table shares one recipe. `selected` is the
only state a row owns — set it from your selection model.
declarations.name: RrTableRow

members.name: selected
members.description: Marks the row as selected — tint fill plus the solid action rail, strongest row state.

attributes.name: selected
attributes.description: Marks the row as selected — tint fill plus the solid action rail, strongest row state.

declarations.description:
`<rr-table>` — a structural data table composed from `rr-table-row` and
`rr-table-cell`.

Raw `<tr>`/`<td>` can't be slotted into a custom element (the HTML parser
drops table tags outside a `<table>` context), so the family uses CSS
table display with explicit ARIA table semantics: this host is the
`role="table"`, rows are `role="row"`, cells `role="cell"` /
`role="columnheader"`. Cells accept arbitrary content — badges, menus,
buttons.

Row states are owned here (zebra striping, hover tint, selected rail) so
every table in the system shares one visual language. The hover tint only
renders when `interactive` is set — accent green signals interactivity,
never decoration.
declarations.name: RrTable

`<rr-tab-list>` — the accessible tab strip container.

Wraps `<rr-tab>` elements and manages selection state, keyboard navigation
(left/right arrows, Home, End), and ARIA attributes.

declarations.description:
An outlined, uppercase tag / chip component.

The deliberate inverse of `<rr-badge>`: where the badge is a filled pill for
status, the tag is a square-cornered (radius.sm), transparent-filled, bordered
label for skills, categories, and metadata. Content is rendered UPPERCASE with
all-caps letter-spacing, so authors pass normal-case text.

Uses component-level design tokens for all visual properties. Brand theming
cascades automatically via CSS custom properties on `:root`.
declarations.name: RrTag

members.name: variant
members.description:
Emphasis level. `default` is the standard visible outline (alt text,
muted-foreground border) that reads correctly standalone — use it for skill
tags and most labels. `subtle` is a quieter treatment (muted text,
elevated-border) for dense or secondary contexts.

declarations.description:
A transient floating notification — announces, lingers briefly, and leaves.

Where `rr-alert` is an in-flow tinted banner that belongs to the page,
the toast is a floating neutral surface with a variant accent rail.
Placement is the consumer's job (a fixed-position region in the app
corner); the component owns the surface, the status semantics, the
optional auto-dismiss timer (paused while hovered or focused), and the
dismiss affordance.
declarations.name: RrToast

slots.description: Optional action (e.g. an Undo rr-button variant="ghost")
slots.name: action

members.name: variant
members.description: Status variant: neutral (default), success, warning, danger, info. Expressed via the accent rail and heading color.

members.name: heading
members.description: Optional bold heading rendered above the message, in the variant accent color.

members.name: duration
members.description: Auto-dismiss after this many milliseconds. 0 (default) means persistent until dismissed. Timer pauses while hovered or focused.

members.name: dismissible
members.description: Shows the dismiss button. On by default — a toast the user can't clear is a trap.

members.name: dismiss
members.description: Close the toast. Single source of truth — always dispatches `rr-toast-close`.

declarations.description:
A form-associated toggle switch for binary on/off settings.

The pill-shaped track and sliding knob are rendered in shadow DOM;
the hidden native `<input type="checkbox">` provides focus, keyboard,
and label-click semantics. `ElementInternals` handles form participation.

Usage:
  <rr-toggle name="darkMode" label="Dark mode" checked></rr-toggle>
  <rr-toggle name="notify">Email notifications</rr-toggle>
declarations.name: RrToggle
